text:
Match each item in Column A with its description in Column B.
Column A
(1) the least count of an instrument
(2) the vernier constant
(3) zero error
(4) the pitch of a screw
Column B
(a) The distance its tip moves along its axis in one full turn.
(b) The difference between one main scale division and one vernier scale division.
(c) The reading an instrument gives when it should read zero.
(d) The smallest measurement it can read directly.

points.text: (1) the least count of an instrument goes with (d).
(2) the vernier constant goes with (b).
(3) zero error goes with (c).
(4) the pitch of a screw goes with (a).
